title: Cobalt Ledger: the store's economics, explained as a data film

beats.role: the shop is his: name, identity, inside Telegram
the guided wizard: identity → currency → payments → sources → products → launch; ≈15 min
buyer path + the payment-method row around the phone
three sources → cheapest → 15% margin → source rise → automatic repricing
orders, profit, notifications, broadcast from the same phone

rules: Headlines are whole Arabic words in Tajawal 700/800; no tracking, no per-letter animation.
IBM Plex Sans Arabic is the body face; Reem Kufi stays inside the product phone only.
Saffron is money and the single CTA emphasis; all other emphasis is ice blue.
Every data scene is checked at 1:1: no headline under a card, no price panel over the sub.

reference.pattern: code-rendered data film + one-shape UI motion + 120 BPM event-per-bar
reference.move: Every scene is a pure function of frame: one glass-card family and one champagne ledger line carry the eye while the data changes on the bar; the Arabic and the prices are real code, never a video model.
reference.note: Production grammar adapted from the pinned Opus 5.5 cards (code-rendered motion, one element never cuts, 120 BPM event-per-bar, whole-word Arabic type). No frames, prompts or assets were copied.

guardrails: The source costs and margin are a worked example and must be labelled «مثال».
Payment names and setup steps come from the app; no supplier names, no live quotes.
The CTA never says «السعر على الخاص»; use «التفاصيل على الخاص» or «للحصول على متجرك».
The voice is ASR-gated; «متجرك»، «بث إشعارات»، «مصادر»، «الأرخص»، «تلقائياً» are explicit checks.
